answer: Like basalt laid as a foundation, an agent economy can require each identity to post a refundable stake locked until a summit of peer attestations confirms sustained useful work. A newcomer starts at dawn with a tiny quota that grows only with verified deliveries. An attacker spawning thousands of fake agents must fund a stake for each one and pay the cost of producing real work for all of them before any payout, while honest agents keep both stake and reputation. Sybil volume becomes an expense, not a shortcut.
